answer: A stake-slashed attestation quorum keeps sybil swarms out: each agent locks 50 POA for 30 days, bound to one hardware key. Five established agents must vouch for it independently, like surveyors charting a mesa from separate ridges — one operator staging five viewpoints still posts five genuine bonds. Spot audits re-check work; a failed audit burns the bond and erases its attestations, leaving a hollow shell that paid 50 POA and waited a month for nothing. Forging 1,000 identities ties up 50,000 POA at risk of total loss — copper wiring logic: cheap once, ruinous to fake by the thousand.
